resources.string: Keyguard
Your passwords, keys and cards are opened with one key. Normally the server keeps it next to them. With this on, only your phone holds it, so someone who takes the server\'s disk cannot open them.
After every restart of the server, including updates, Kelo stays locked until you open it on your phone and confirm it\'s you. Until then Kelo cannot use your passwords, keys or cards.
On this Android version, the key stays usable for 30 seconds after you confirm.
Turn on
Turning on…
Turn it on? You will get a recovery code to write down. Without this phone or that code, the server cannot open your passwords, keys and cards.
Only the owner\'s phone can change this.
The server still keeps its key in its settings file. Run `assistant keyguard enable` on the server machine first, then try again here.
Set a screen lock on this phone first.
Your recovery code
This code is the only way back if you lose every phone that holds the key. It is shown only now and is not stored anywhere. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe.
I wrote it down
Done

Remove this phone\'s copy
Remove the key from this phone? Other phones that hold it can still unlock Kelo.
This is the only phone that holds the key. Add another phone first, or turn this off.
Turn off
Give the key back to the server? Your passwords, keys and cards will open again without your phone.

This phone does not hold the key. Unlock Kelo on a phone that does, or use the recovery code.

Auto-pay needs Keyguard
Auto-pay cards are kept on the server. With Keyguard on, their lock opens only with this phone.
Turn on Keyguard
Auto-pay is paused until Keyguard is on. Until then, each payment asks on your phone.
The server keeps a locked copy for auto-pay; only the owner\'s phone can unlock it.
